name: Flaming Sphere Rune (5-6)
disable: DC 21 Thievery check (trained) to erase the rune without triggering the sensor, or Dispel Magic (2rd rank; counteract DC 18) to counteract the rune

items.name: Flaming Sphere
items.text:
Trigger A living creature touches the sensor area.

---

Effect The rune detonates creating a flaming sphere in the sensor area. This is a 3nd-rank flaming sphere spell that deals 4d6 fire damage (DC 21 basic Reflex save save).

text: An invisible rune creates an invisible, spherical magical sensor with a 5-foot radius.
